title: ForceClose !
description: Mod that lets you force-close the game using a command
body:
# ForceClose 
A really simple utility mod that lets you force close the game via a ingame command or textureless item

Made it to work in conjunction with KubeJS in a modpack of mine, can be used elsewhere
irdc abt props if u use this, just join my discord
